reviewTitle: Comfy shoe, but the tread didn't last.
reviewDescription: The shoes are comfy right out of the box and fit my foot well. I have owned them for about 2 months, with minimal runs during that time, and the tread near the balls of my feet are already gone. I wondered if they came that way and I just hadn't noticed, but I have a second pair I've bought as a backup and the tread is fully intact in the same region of that shoe. I know these are "trail" shoes, but after12 miles of pavement running in the last week I could easily see the difference in tread height between Sunday and Saturday. I know the shoes are "cheap", but I expected better durability in the tread as I feel the shoes are worn out with less than 50 miles of running.

reviewTitle: Sizing seems to be all over the place!
reviewDescription: The one thing that I absolutely know, is what shoe size I wear in several brands and I am very consistent. When I first began to wear Altra running shoes, both the company and the runner that told me about them said I should go up a half size from my normal tennis shoe size. I always wore a 10 wide so I went to a 10.5 altra and they fit perfect! Since 2017 I have worn nothing but 10.5 Altra Olympus tennis shoes. So I purchased the Nortiv 8 in a 10.5 as well since every review I read said this would be the right size for me. I took the left shoe out the box today and my foot was swimming in it. I put it sole to sole with my Olympus 5 and the shoe was huge. Easily an inch longer than my altra olympus 5. I probably should have checked the right shoe as well, but I wanted to return them brand new so I boxed it right back up. Now I haven't given up on this yet, as I liked the way the shoe looked so I am reordering them in a size 10 to see if it is a better fit. I did check the label on the left shoe, and it did say 10.5 so it was correct. When I put my foot in the shoe, it felt really big and my toe was way too far from the front of my shoe. Knowing I will immediately add powerstep insoles to the shoe, I thought maybe it just feels big because I haven't added the insole yet. However, when I put the shoe sole to sole with my Altra, and saw that it passed it up in the race by an inch, I said I don't think I can make these work. When the 10's come in, I will give them a try and see if the fit is better. Now the reason why I said the sizing seems to be all over the place is because I read several reviews that said people needed to size up from their normal size. WHAT? Size up? This shoe was gigantic for me in a 10.5. But I have no doubt, for those reviewers...that's what they needed to do. That's why I say sizing seems to be all over the place. The one other thing I noticed, is that the toe box on the Nortiv 8 looked even bigger than my Altra Olympus. If I can find the right length, that should not be a problem. My feet are fairly wide. I have fallen arches and must use an orthotic, so the extra room in the toe box will be welcome. But I cannot have that much extra length. I use a powerstep pinnacle insole with an added arch cookie and metatarsal bar so my feet do not constantly kill me. My podiatrist taught me to build up the insole this way and it has given me much relief. We will see if the size 10 works out better for me.
